coordinates: Coordinates are pixels from the upper-left of the full USB image after rotation to its upright orientation. Subtract the archived crop origin in setup.json to locate a coordinate in a lossless frame.
measurement: The thin near-wall liquid edge crosses the front face bearing the upright US markings. The fitted arc uses visible flanks on both sides of the hoses and a local edge adjustment at each marked column. Each frame uses its own print position and scale.
column_offsets: Horizontal offsets follow the slopes of the printed spines with height.
interpolation: A monotone piecewise cubic interpolates cup volume against native tick height. A linear extension of the lowest marked interval handles a contact below that interval.
consistent_series: Each position is offset to the physical side anchor at side-focus. The median across positions readable in every frame supplies the additive endpoint and withdrawal columns. The direct columns retain the readings on each face of the printed scale.

sharp_outer_pair.basis: Both endpoint frames resolve all front positions. This independent total spans both probes.

rerouted.accounting: The probe and repeat series begins again after the tubes were moved. Each successive direct cup volume uses the median of all matched front positions; reported withdrawals subtract adjacent endpoint volumes.
rerouted.edge: When opaque printing covers the near-wall contact, the fit uses the liquid on clear glass to either side. Seed coordinates delimit the visible near edge. A robust cubic fits the color and luminance transitions in the bright liquid rim after red ink is masked. The cubic uses x = (native_x - origin_x) / scale_x. At the lower swapped and return-check levels the more curved near arc and local flank adjustments locate the contact.

long_return_cross_check.interpretation: The ratio compares the change in scale load with the cup graduation reading over this particular transfer. Intrinsic syrup density requires an independent calibration.

A.systematic_reading_note: All repeat readings share the measuring cup, camera geometry and contact interpretation.
